details: Implemented sub-cockpit workspace selection tabs (All Modules, Command, Studio, Monitor, Configure) and synchronized filtering state dynamically.
Upgraded live page audits to extract robots.txt indexes, parse SSL redirect chains, and verify sitemaps status.
Added multi-threaded ThreadPoolExecutor validation of unique target outbound links. Reports status codes and penalizes SEO score on dead links.
Integrated jsPDF reports compiler to generate comprehensive PDF downloads directly from frontend auditor tabs.
Built and registered deployable council-room route under the COMMAND cockpit workspace grid to summon independent LLM advisor debates.
